Bundled chat-rendering libraries (unmodified distribution files):

- KaTeX 0.16.11 (JS, CSS, WOFF2 fonts) — MIT License — https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
- highlight.js 11.10.0 (common languages build) — BSD 3-Clause License — https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js
- Mermaid 11.4.1 — MIT License — https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid

Embedded CPython (downloaded at build time by tools/python-android/prepare.py):

  Includes OpenSSL (Apache License 2.0), SQLite (public domain) and other components listed in the CPython LICENSE.
